name: read_git
description: Read a git repository through the local git binary. view=overview returns the current branch, upstream ahead/behind, working-tree changes, branches, stashes and the commit graph (each commit with its parents and refs). view=commit returns one commit's message and changed files with line counts; omit commit for the working tree against HEAD. view=files lists the repository's tracked and untracked files, without ignored ones, plus the workspace's prefix inside the repository. view=file returns one file's text: the working copy, or its content at commit when given (files over 1 MiB or binary are reported, not returned). view=file_diff returns the patch of one path in that commit, or in the working tree when commit is omitted. Reads only; it never fetches or changes the repository.

path.description: Repository-relative path for file and file_diff.

branch.description: Limit the overview graph to this branch; omit for all branches.

name: sync_git
description: Fetch, pull (fast-forward only) or push the current branch with the user's own git configuration and credential helper. Never prompts for a password: when git has no stored credential it fails and the error says so. Returns git's output with any credentials in URLs removed.
